scope: Additive final public-source recheck for the permanent Home Village Hero phase. No new standard battle rule or value is imported.
game_version: Public pages consulted on 2026-09-23; none supplies a client build or a complete deterministic Hero Banner contract.

sources.title: About Heroes & Pets
facts: Up to four Hero Banners may be placed; assigned defending Heroes patrol around their banners and defend against attacks.
sources.limitations: No radius, route, acquisition, target priority, pursuit, return, respawn, collision, hitbox, or tick-order specification is published.

sources.title: THE TOWN HALL 17 UPDATE IS HERE!
facts: Players can choose and assign defending Heroes to Hero Banners.
sources.limitations: This release note does not specify their defensive movement or combat timing.

sources.title: Get Ready for Ranked! - Update
facts: Tournament Mode increases defending Hero damage and hitpoints by 20 percent.
sources.limitations: The modifier is explicitly mode-scoped and supplies no standard Home Village patrol or collision contract.

rejected_inferences.rule: Implement a guessed Hero Banner patrol or acquisition radius.
rejected_inferences.reason: The primary sources contain no numerical radius or deterministic movement contract.

rejected_inferences.rule: Apply Tournament Mode Hero modifiers in standard battles.
rejected_inferences.reason: The official release note scopes them to Tournament Mode.

rejected_inferences.rule: Treat shared unit collision geometry or Hero icons as measured battlefield hitboxes or sprites.
rejected_inferences.reason: The checked primary pages provide no Hero-specific collision or presentation geometry; the 2026-09-21 geometry and asset audits remain unresolved.
